blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — A 50-year-old man believed to be under the influence of alcohol died early Saturday after he suddenly stepped into the path of an oncoming bus along the national highway in Barangay Lunocan, Manolo Fortich town, Bukidnon. Police identified the victim as a resident of Barangay Inutlanan, Claveria, Misamis Oriental. He was rushed to the Bukidnon Provincial Hospital in Barangay San Miguel of Manolo Fortich where attending physicians declared him dead on arrival due to severe injuries.
